claim: Whether the background carries outlines at all, which quietly declares which anime tradition the film belongs to. Lineless painted backgrounds read filmic and expensive; full ink lines read graphic and manga-adjacent, and glue the background to the character art.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: lineless background, painted scenery without outlines
faint background lineart, soft outlined scenery
bold ink outlined background, heavy ink scenery

review.issue: The "none" clause "lineless background, painted scenery without outlines" ends in a prose negation. The positive tag "lineless" is doing all the work and is not the danbooru spelling.
review.fix: "no lineart, painted background" - drop the trailing clause.
